text:
sam: deploy-bot promo for v2026.03 stalled, holding change window. cannot get artifact to staging.
deploy-bot: ERROR uploading artifact chunk: Multipart upload stalled (connection timeout). upload_id=abcd-1234, attempts=12 :disappointed: 
maría: @sam can you paste the last error block from the deploy logs?
alex: is this the same s3 mirror we saw flake on last week?
sam: looks related to mirror-eu1. retry loop is backing off, but uploads never finish.
infra-bot: recent events: 2026-03-23T14:02Z mirror-eu1 ingress latency spike, spike->throttle applied by proxy. ref: https://status.internal/mirror-eu1
renee: if proxy is throttling multipart commits, we'll either wait for health or manual-promote previous artifact. what's the risk if we pin previous image?
maria: risk = missing build that includes doc-format fix. product asked to ship it in this window. but EM said not blocking if infra holds.
alex: ops-oncall can you increase the upload retry timeout + disable parallel chunks for this upload? quick patch to rollout helper: `--multipart-parallel=1 --timeout=120s`
ops-oncall: I can do that, will kick off a guarded retry in ~5m. if still failing we'll decide rollback vs wait.
sam: decision proposal: hold for 30m for retries + mirror heal. if still failing at T+30 -> manual-promote previous digest and open a hotfix ticket for the doc-format patch.
renee: 👍 on that plan. also add a note to release notes about the doc fix being deferred.
maria: I'll draft release-notes snippet and mark as held.
infra-bot: logs (tail):
```
2026-03-23T14:03:12Z upload-part chunk=11/512 err=ETIMEDOUT
2026-03-23T14:03:28Z retrying upload-part (backoff=8s)
2026-03-23T14:04:10Z upload-part chunk=11/512 err=EOF
2026-03-23T14:05:00Z multipart finalize failed: incomplete upload
```
alex: sounds like partial stream got stalled mid-chunk, parallel retries just pile up. disabling parallel should reduce head-of-line blocking.
sam: I'm going to pin the canary to last-good digest if ops-oncall wants to start the retry. will not promote until we see success.
ops-oncall: retry kicked with modified flags. monitoring logs. I'll update in 10m. :eyes:
deploy-bot: upload retry started (upload_id=abcd-1234, mode=serial, timeout=120s)
ops-oncall: update 10m: some chunks progressing but still intermittent 504s, mirror ingress still degrade.
renee: consensus? Wait another 20m or promote now?
maria: product says non-blocking, prefer promote previous image to meet SLAs.
alex: +1 promote previous digest, open hotfix PR targeting canary for doc fix.
sam: ok manual-promote previous digest and add a rollback note. will run promote now: `deployctl promote --from-digest sha256:ff11... --to=staging --reason="mirror stall"`
deploy-bot: manual promote started, recording audit.
ops-oncall: I'll keep a watch on mirror and cancel promote if upload suddenly succeeds (unlikely).
renee: adding followup: create postmortem ticket, include mirror-eu1 throttle event and consider mirror failover in deployctl.
maria: release-notes draft: "Staged rollout held due to artifact mirror upload failure; previous build promoted to meet release window. Doc-format fix will follow in a hotfix release."
sam: good. tagging PMs and release manager. closing hold with manual promote at 2026-03-23T14:40Z.
infra-bot: note: created incident INC-2026-0312 for mirror-eu1 ingress spike.
ops-oncall: final: staging now at sha256:ff11..., canary flagged for hotfix. I'll post results to #release-updates once green.
